Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.builtin

Class PopupBlockerExtension

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.builtin.PopupBlockerExtension
All Implemented Interfaces:
BrowserExtension
public final class PopupBlockerExtension extends Object implements BrowserExtension
A first-party reference extension, and the canonical example of the BrowserExtension SPI: it suppresses popups that were not triggered by a direct user gesture (the classic window.open-on-load ad), while letting user-initiated popups through.

Registered via META-INF/services so it is discovered by ServiceLoader exactly like a third-party jar, exercising the same code path. It needs only Permission.POPUP.
